research.rule: Public buyer-side evidence only. Seller listings and generic market size are not demand.

price_decision.decision: Do not quote either number against a bounty below it. Use the posted bounty amount or wait for a buyer-owned issue that supports the service price.

targets.buyer_or_notice: the tiny corp / tinygrad bounty board
targets.observed_budget: Current four amounts unreadable; historical board ranges include $500+.
targets.public_route: Confirm an open item and amount on its linked issue, comment publicly, then submit a merge-ready PR.
targets.disqualifier: Current amounts were not verified; hardware/kernel scope may exceed 48 hours.
targets.founder_action: Confirm one white/open issue and its posted amount before writing code. Never quote above it without written buyer agreement.

targets.public_route: Comment on the issue and lock only with a draft PR showing real progress.
targets.fit: Named public issue and merge-gated payment.
targets.disqualifier: $500 is below both the $2,500 catalog and $1,500 narrow pilot; old and competitive.
targets.founder_action: Take only if $500 is rational or use it to reject the current code-service price for public bounties.

targets.buyer_or_notice: Reddit r/gameDevClassifieds — paid gothic pixel-artist request
targets.public_route: Public thread reply with original portfolio only; no personal-email harvest.
targets.fit: Actual buyer request for original character work; later sprites/loops may fit the $800 pack.
targets.disqualifier: Thread body was not independently readable; may be filled; stated budget is below $800.
targets.founder_action: Verify the thread is still unpaid and attach an original pixel portfolio before any reply.

targets.buyer_or_notice: ScaleUp Recruiting — Vendor Security Questionnaire Specialist
targets.fit: Explicit SIG/CAIQ/custom questionnaire completion. A one-file evidence-only sprint can be an alternate.
targets.disqualifier: LATAM-only contractor seat, 2–4 years GRC requested, no one-shot budget published.
targets.founder_action: Apply only if geography and experience fit; offer the sprint only as a written alternate for an immediately due file.

targets.public_route: Lightning Bounties claim plus closing PR.
targets.disqualifier: Two PRs already linked and posted amount far below catalog price.
targets.founder_action: Stand down unless existing PRs fail and the maintainer publicly reopens the need.

targets.buyer_or_notice: Lightning Bounties feed — Primal Android #1055 and Web #133
targets.public_route: Use the public platform and linked GitHub issue.
targets.disqualifier: Micropayment-sized, outside preferred 45-day issue window, possible overlap.
targets.founder_action: Only take one unclaimed issue at the posted amount if its economics independently make sense.

targets.disqualifier: Requires real Windows hardware with >64 logical cores; competitive; non-USD reward below catalog economics.
targets.founder_action: Skip unless qualifying hardware is already available and the posted reward is independently acceptable.

targets.buyer_or_notice: FyreFlight Games — Pixel Animator, Under the Flag
targets.public_route: Organization-published route only if the page reopens.

ten_day_sequence.action: Choose legal payee/rail privately and validate one live posted buyer amount.
ten_day_sequence.success: One target has open state, written amount, scope, and public route.
ten_day_sequence.kill_or_revise: If none supports at least $800, freeze catalog-price outbound.

ten_day_sequence.action: Qualify tinygrad current board and the Reddit pixel thread before writing code or replying.
ten_day_sequence.success: One open target passes all disqualifiers.
ten_day_sequence.kill_or_revise: Closed, claimed, or sub-economic means stand down.

ten_day_sequence.action: Founder reviews and sends exactly one platform-native response from outreach.json.
ten_day_sequence.success: Public reply/application exists and is truthful.
ten_day_sequence.kill_or_revise: No scraping, DM escape, or price mismatch.

ten_day_sequence.action: Only after written fit, issue private SOW/invoice or accept a funded platform milestone.
ten_day_sequence.kill_or_revise: No written yes means no work.
Cure once or refund/withhold per SOW.

ten_day_sequence.action: Record authorization, settlement, payout, and bank availability separately.
ten_day_sequence.success: A real paid state or an honest $0 closeout.
ten_day_sequence.kill_or_revise: Do not rename interest or a PR as revenue.

research_gap: Fewer than 20 targets were retained because current public evidence did not support 20 buyer-side opportunities. Many were closed, sub-$100, bot-hostile, agent-only, or misfit software RFPs. No paid public post named a failing local-model job.
